What molecular account explains the observed solution absorption of PXX1 and PXX2 with and without added B(C6F5)3, and what can the available evidence establish about the species present? Investigate the adequacy and identifiability of that account without presupposing an association structure or a unique stoichiometry. Define the optical observable, medium, electronic states and spectral comparison used. Any species-population or association claim must use balanced composition and justified thermodynamic/solution assumptions. Test the ambiguity relevant to the proposed explanation; unresolved experimental features alone do not establish coexistence or one unique species.
